sh: Trump, Xi and Putin to meet in China
headline: Trump, Xi and Putin are due to hold their first three-way meeting in China on Thursday
summary: The leaders of the US, China and Russia are due to meet together for the first time on Thursday 19 November, in Shenzhen, during the APEC summit. The White House says the main topic is reducing nuclear weapons.
why: The US, Russia and China are the world’s biggest nuclear powers, and their three leaders have never met as a group. What they agree, or fail to agree, could shape arms control for years. The meeting also comes while the wars in Ukraine and Iran are still going on.
simple: The presidents of the United States, China and Russia plan to sit down together on Thursday in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. It would be the first time the three meet as a group. The US says it wants to talk about having fewer nuclear weapons.

event.t: The White House said on Friday 13 November that President Trump will meet China’s leader Xi Jinping and Russia’s President Vladimir Putin together. It would be the first three-way meeting of the countries’ leaders.
The Kremlin said the meeting will be held on 19 November in Shenzhen, on the sidelines of the APEC summit. China’s foreign ministry confirmed the place and the day on Monday 16 November.
The White House says Trump wants to discuss reducing the number of nuclear weapons in the world.
US officials told ABC News that Trump expects to discuss Iran with Xi and Putin, but does not plan to discuss Russia’s war in Ukraine at the three-way meeting.

effects.label: Arms control
effects.t: A joint commitment on nuclear weapons by the three powers would be new. No three-way agreement of this kind exists today.

effects.label: Ukraine
effects.t: The war is not on the agenda of the three-way meeting, US officials told ABC News. Analysts quoted by Al Jazeera say the meeting lets Putin show strength while the war is set aside.

effects.label: Iran
effects.t: Trump is expected to raise Iran with Xi and Putin, according to US officials.

background.t: APEC, the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum, holds its leaders’ summit in Shenzhen this week.

updates.t: Trump leaves Washington for Asia. He is due at the ASEAN summit in Manila first, then at the APEC summit in Shenzhen, where the three-way meeting is planned for Thursday.
Trump arrives in Manila for the ASEAN summit, the first stop of his Asia trip. In Shenzhen he is also due to hold a separate meeting with Xi, NBC News reports.

Trump says he will also talk about Ukraine, Iran, the economy and trade with Xi and Putin. US officials had said the war in Ukraine was not on the agenda. China calls the meeting one of “groundbreaking significance”.

In Manila, Trump held his first Quad meeting with the leaders of Japan, India and Australia. Their statement voiced “grave concerns” about economic coercion, including export restrictions, without naming a country. Trump also signed a trade statement with Thailand; the final deal is expected in the coming weeks.
updates.why: China has objected to the Quad as an effort to surround it, and the meeting comes two days before Trump’s talks with Xi.

updates.t: Trump arrived in Shenzhen on Wednesday and was greeted at the airport by Xi Jinping himself, which CNN calls a break with precedent. Xi opened the APEC summit with calls for free trade and more cooperation on artificial intelligence, CNBC reports.
